_about: Replies from real Bose devices, from bosectl's captures and fixtures (github.com/aaronsb/bosectl, MIT, commit 70570b29c1d3c9ba775b08a29eaea72385de27b5): each function's payload as a GET answered it, and requests as bosectl's notes give them. qc_ultra2_headphones is the QC Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen), product 4082, firmware 8.2.20; qc_ultra2_earbuds_battery the QC Ultra Earbuds (2nd Gen) battery. Nothing that names or addresses the device is kept.

requests.what: switch to mode 0, Quiet, without a voice prompt (START 31.3)
noise cancelling level 5, auto off, spatial off, wind block off, ANC on (SETGET 31.10)
